Create Validation-Based Fitness Function (Base-Feature-First)

Source: R/fitness_validation.R
dot-make_validation_fitness.Rd

Factory that returns a fitness function for rmoo that selects base features, applies feature transforms on-the-fly, trains on training data, and evaluates objectives on validation data.

.make_validation_fitness(
  train_x,
  train_y,
  train_cohort,
  val_x,
  val_y,
  val_cohort,
  feature_pool,
  max_features,
  objectives,
  constraints,
  regularized,
  alpha,
  feature_transform = "none",
  min_features_required = NULL,
  selection_threshold = "adaptive",
  cache_fitness = TRUE,
  cache_max_entries = Inf
)

Arguments

train_x

Training feature matrix (base features).

train_y

Training response factor.

train_cohort

Training cohort factor.

val_x

Validation feature matrix (base features).

val_y

Validation response factor.

val_cohort

Validation cohort factor.

feature_pool

Character vector of base feature names.

max_features

Maximum base features to include.

objectives

Objective list from define_objectives().

constraints

Constraint list.

regularized

Whether to use regularized regression.

alpha

Elastic net mixing parameter.

feature_transform

Name of the feature transform to apply.

min_features_required

Minimum number of base features.

selection_threshold

Either "adaptive" or a fixed numeric threshold.

cache_fitness

Logical; cache duplicate selected panels during fitness.

cache_max_entries

Maximum entries retained in the fitness cache.

Value

List with wrapper (fitness for rmoo) and evaluate (full eval).
